build_benchmark_server: build a python module to run a gRPC BenchmarkServer that handles unary and streaming benchmark calls
create_generic_benchmark_server: create a GenericBenchmarkServer instance with a fixed response size for gRPC benchmark testing
test_unary_call: test the BenchmarkServer UnaryCall method to verify it returns a SimpleResponse with the correct payload size
test_streaming_call: test the BenchmarkServer StreamingCall method to verify it yields SimpleResponse messages for each request
review_benchmark_service_servicer: review the BenchmarkServer and GenericBenchmarkServer classes that implement the gRPC BenchmarkServiceServicer interface
